applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 7, and 8 in proximity to overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Buildings 1, 7, and 8 are shown on the site plan within potential clearance distance of overhead electric lines (OHE) running along western and southern property boundaries. However, no surveyed elevations of overhead conductors or building elevation sheets with conductor height data are provided. No section views showing dimensions from the outer conductor to building faces or projections are included. The required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified from the submitted documents.

applicableAreas: Building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies) near overhead lines along western and southern boundaries
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets or section views are provided showing building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, roofs) relative to overhead conductors. Surveyed conductor elevations required to verify both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances are not included on the site plan.

applicableAreas: Buildings in proximity to right-of-way with overhead facilities
findings.comment: Existing overhead electric lines are shown in the right-of-way adjacent to the site (Valley View Road frontage). No documentation is provided verifying that buildings maintain the required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearance from these overhead facilities. Surveyed conductor locations and building setbacks from conductors (not just from pole centerline) are not dimensioned on the plans.

applicableAreas: All buildings within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets are provided. Sheet 21 (Preliminary Electrical Design Plan) shows only underground electric infrastructure, not overhead conductors. No surveyed elevations of overhead conductors showing clearance dimensions to building faces and projections are included. Registered surveyor mid-span clearance data is required to demonstrate compliance with vertical clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Section views and plan details showing buildings and site features near overhead lines
findings.comment: No section or plan view exhibits showing dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of buildings and building projections are provided. Clearance verification dimensions are absent from both the site plan and grading plan sheets.

applicableAreas: Overhead electric facilities shown on site plan sheets
findings.comment: While overhead electric lines (OHE) are shown on the existing conditions survey and site plan, no clearance dimensions are provided on the plans. Where clearances would typically be dimensioned, they are completely absent. Dimension lines must originate from the outside conductor (not from pole centerline or utility pole), with specific clearance distances documented for all site features within potential clearance zones.

applicableAreas: Driveways, parking areas, and buildings with potential marginal overhead clearances
findings.comment: Site plan data does not include surveyed conductor heights or estimated overhead line elevations. A registered surveyor mid-span clearance survey is required to determine if proposed site features (driveways, parking, buildings) maintain adequate vertical clearance from overhead lines. Without conductor elevation data, compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where overhead electric lines run and mitigation trees are proposed
findings.comment: Six Mexican Redbud (Cercis canadensis var. mexicana) and two Texas Mountain Laurel (Sophora secundiflora) trees are proposed as mitigation plantings along the southern boundary where overhead electric lines run. These species do not appear in the ECM Appendix F Utility Compatible Shade Trees list and are therefore not acceptable for planting within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors. Additionally, no lateral distance dimensions or clearance documentation between the proposed trees and overhead conductors are provided on the landscape plan.

No plan note requiring owner/contractor notification to Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines is present on the cover sheet, general notes, or site plan. Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003 requires this notification, and it must be documented in the contract documents.
